topics.angle: The ENTIRE history of a country/empire/city in one funny animated story, chapters by era, anachronism gags, maps on every era change. Hook with a concrete vivid question in the first 10 s -> 5-7 beats, each a mini-story with a visual mechanism -> twist -> short recap. Never dry lists.
